data.body: [P1] MDC restoration still occurs after the handler outcome is published. When the task already failed, a fatal restoration error becomes suppressed on that ordinary failure, and this condition skips reporting it because the result is already exceptional; the invocation is returned as `FAILED` and the async worker survives the JVM-fatal cleanup. Successful outcomes also swallow ordinary restoration failures, potentially reusing a worker with stale MDC. Restore before publication—preserving an explicit MDC snapshot for end dispatch—or inspect cleanup/suppressed failures, propagate fatal ones, and retire dirty async workers.
